revision: Calibrate only each real history start; replay every motion thereafter. No interior pose assignment. Max12 deterministic correction trials per history; repeated initial state ends search. No model, score, training or scientific claim.
acceptance: Exact full agent and sensor pose AND last2 raw RGB hashes and last8 actual motions after actual histories; full crossed suffix replay if all joins match. Starts may differ and all calibration attempts are retained. No transformed images or copied states mid-history.
